summary: Winter camping is a growing trend in the US. Over 35 million Americans camped in an RV in 2022, and more than 15 million Americans went camping for the first time in the last two years. In 2024, 93% of campers feel more relaxed after time spent camping. Popular winter camping activities include campfires, quinzee building, snowball fights, skiing, snowboarding, and cozy indoor activities like hot cocoa at local cafes and movie nights. Crafting and outdoor cooking are also trending among campers.
